documents.title: Specification and design-document system
documents.purpose: Keep technical meaning in Markdown and check declared structure without a second writable contract.
documents.audience: Authors, reviewers and tool implementers familiar with Markdown and Git.
documents.scope: Single-file and multi-file specifications, design documents, declarations, navigation and mandatory agent context.
documents.non_goals: Publication server, custom renderer, expression evaluation, general prose formatting and product-specific contracts.
